usage: Use 「整數」 when you mean a whole number with no decimal part or fraction. 佢考數學，淨係要識整數。
It is often used in math lessons, exams, and basic number talk. 呢條題目要你填整數。
「整數」 can be contrasted with 「小數」 and 「分數」. 5 係整數，3.2 唔係。
It can also be used in more formal writing about numbers and data. 呢組數據全部都係整數。
